issues.summary: No explicit k-means seed or n_init control. Verify sklearn default n_init=10 is used, or run 3 seeds and report K* variance.
Holdout has ~4 tokens/cluster at k=256. Report median error, exclude clusters with <5 holdout tokens from K*, and report fraction excluded.

advisory.summary: GELU'(z) saturates at 1 for large z. Tokens with z=5 and z=50 both get GELU'~1 but produce different outputs. Report within-cluster z-norm std as diagnostic.
If k=1 null error < 10%, the 5% K* threshold may be nearly trivial. Also report k at which error drops to 50% of k=1 error.

notes: Premise is sound: corrects cycle 085 Taylor linearization error with actual GELU output reconstruction.
Validation assertion (hooked output vs manual gelu(z)@W_out+b_out) is a strong guard against silent bugs.
Cross-check against cycle 085 k=256 error (must be strictly lower) is well-designed.
